title: Secondary Mathematics 3 (with STACK)
description: Secondary Mathematics 3 from the Republic of South Sudan's Ministry of General Education and Instruction, covering: Logarithms; measurement and geometry (accuracy, loci and the equation of a circle); algebra (quadratics, binomial expansion, sequences and series, matrices and transformations); and an introduction to calculus. This is a variant of the original textbook with interactive STACK examples embedded, so learners can practise with automatically marked questions.
authors: The Republic of South Sudan, Ministry of General Education and Instruction
subject: math
